credit_line: Purchased by the Association of the Arts of New Jersey State Museum with a gift from Mary Lea Johnson
description: A glowing red river runs between two banks populated with dark gray buildings. Above is a bright blue sky with a shining, white and yellow sun projecting white rays. Sunspots float around the sun. On the banks of the river, smokestacks send blue smoke into the sky.
title: East River No. I
